content.short: GraphQL is a query language that lets APIs fetch required data quickly and in a clean format.
content.description: GraphQL is a declarative data query language that enables precise, flexible API scripting for complex datasets. With GraphQL, developers can request the relationships and connections of a target data item and receive the exact fields they need in a single round trip, rather than issuing multiple RESTful requests. This approach speeds up data delivery and expands the accessible data without increasing network traffic or the total number of requests, helping client applications load data more efficiently and predictably.
